features.name: Teleport Object
features.description: Starting at 1st level, as an action, teleport a small unattended object within 30 ft into your hand, or from your hand to a space within 30 ft. Max 5 lbs, fits in a 1-ft cube. Weight limit increases: 10 lbs (L6), 15 lbs (L14), 20 lbs (L18).

payload.name: Teleport Object
payload.description: Teleport an unattended object ≤5 lbs within 30 ft to your hand or vice versa. Weight limit scales with level.

features.name: Shift Space
features.description:
At 1st level, once per turn, spend movement up to half your speed to teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within that distance. Requires nonzero speed.

At 3rd level: spend full speed (speed = 0) and a 2nd level+ spell slot to teleport further:

| Slot Level | Distance |
|---|---|
| 2nd | 30 ft |
| 3rd | 60 ft |
| 4th | 120 ft |
| 5th | 240 ft |
| 6th | 480 ft |
| 7th+ | 960 ft |

Hitting an occupied space: 4d6 force damage, pushed to nearest unoccupied space.

features.name: Tactical Swap
features.description: At 6th level, when a willing creature within 60 ft starts its turn or when you or a creature within 60 ft is attacked, use your reaction to swap positions with that willing creature. If used during an attack, the target becomes whoever now occupies the attacked space. Uses equal to proficiency bonus; regain all on long rest.

payload.name: Tactical Swap
payload.description: Swap positions with a willing creature within 60 ft (at turn start or when either of you is attacked). Attack redirects to the new occupant.

features.name: Familiar Locations
features.description: Starting at 14th level, spend 1 hour familiarizing yourself with a location. Then, as an action, teleport yourself and up to CHA modifier (min 1) willing creatures within 30 ft to that location (same plane). Can store up to CHA modifier (min 1) familiar locations. Uses equal to proficiency bonus per day; regain all on long rest.

payload.name: Familiar Locations
payload.description: Teleport to a familiar location (same plane), bringing up to CHA mod willing creatures within 30 ft.

features.name: Dimensional Ambler
features.description: Starting at 18th level, as an action, transport yourself and up to CHA modifier (min 1) willing creatures within 30 ft to the Astral or Ethereal Plane. Transported creatures must remain within 60 ft of you. Return all to Material Plane as a bonus action. 1/long rest.

payload.name: Dimensional Ambler
payload.description: Transport yourself and up to CHA mod allies within 30 ft to Astral or Ethereal Plane. Return as bonus action.
